thread:
Sophie: FYI AcmeRetail is seeing embedding timeouts, p1. Spikes in 5xxs started at ~09:12 UTC. Can platform + runtime owners commit to mitigation timeline?

Raj: I'm looking. Logs show 503 spikes aligning with a burst at 09:12. Likely coldstart + KV cache miss on dedicated pool. Will triage now.

Alex: Routing team — do we have a fallback model variant we can route to immediately? If we can route 20% of traffic to a smaller model that might buy time.

Oliver: Runtime: warm pool is under pressure for this tenant. I can increase warm pool size for dedicated customers but need a config change and a quick validation — ~2-3m to apply, ~10-15m for stable warmups.

Emily: From CS: AcmeRetail flagged potential SLA escalation in 30m if errors continue. Need ETA for fix + a temporary workaround message I can send.

Raj: Proposed temporary workaround: enable request-level fallback to rwd-mini and bump prefix cache TTL to 30m for the tenant. Doing runbook steps now.

Raj: Logs snippet:```
[09:12:18] embeddings-service rtx: 503 gateway timeout - kv_miss=1 batch_size=1
[09:12:19] scheduler: queue_len=42 p99=1284ms
```

Raj: Runbook commands (admin API):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/route/fallback" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"customer":"acme","fallback_model":"rwd-mini","pct":20}'
# set tenant cache TTL
curl -X POST "https://admin.redwood/api/v1/tenant/acme/cache" -d '{"prefix_ttl_secs":1800}'
```

Alex: I created a PR to change routing policy and add a short-circuit condition: https://git.redwood/infra/routers/pull/4421 — @Oliver can you review? It's mainly a policy flip to allow fallback for impacted tenants.

Oliver: Reviewing now. If approved I'll deploy hotfix + scale warm pool. ETA ~25-30m from now for both steps.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: routing-hotfix-4421 -> 10% traffic (canary id=can-8802)

Sophie: Can we confirm explicit owners and timelines so I can tell the customer?

Raj: Triage & monitoring owner: Raj. Routing PR owner: Alex. Runtime scaling + deploy owner: Oliver. Target: hotfix live by 09:40 UTC (~28m). If hotfix not live, auto-enable fallback at 09:50 UTC.

Emily: I'll tell AcmeRetail: hotfix targeted ~09:40, fallback at ~09:50. Ask them to pause heavy batch jobs until we confirm.

Alex: Quick code review ping: @Oliver @Raj please leave approval/comments on PR #4421. Also flag me if we need to rollback. We should schedule an oncall checkout for 1h after deploy.

ops-bot: Oncall rotation pinged: Maria (oncall) assigned for 1h post-deploy - notif sent.

Sophie: Thanks everyone. I'll update the customer after deploy + 15m metrics check. :thumbsup:

Action items (short):
- Raj: finish triage, enable cache TTL change, monitor spikes (now -> +60m)
- Alex: shepherd PR #4421 and coordinate routing canary
- Oliver: review PR, scale warm pool, deploy hotfix (~25-30m)
- Emily: customer comms and escalation tracking
- Maria: oncall watch for 1h post-deploy

Sophie: Closing loop once metrics stable. If anything blocks, ping this thread and escalate to eng-oncall.
